[acp-report-controller:v1]
Call acp_report_controller exactly once with action=tick and leaseToken=LEASE_TOKEN. If status is delivery_pending, call message exactly once with action=send, message equal byte-for-byte to the returned message, and final=false; then stop. If status is none_due, stop. If status is terminal_acked or tracking_lost, call automations with action=remove and jobId=JOB_ID, then call acp_report_controller with action=release and the same leaseToken; then stop. For delivery_missing, delivery_uncertain, or error, do not send, remove, release, relaunch, or run shell commands; stop. Never compose, summarize, edit, split, or reuse report text.
